Class NativeRuntimeLoader

java.lang.Object
com.github.copilot.ffi.NativeRuntimeLoader
public final class NativeRuntimeLoader extends Object
Locates the runtime.node native binary, extracts it to a versioned cache directory, and returns the filesystem path for JNA to load.

Resolution order:

  1. COPILOT_CLI_PATH — checks for runtime.node alongside the configured CLI or in its npm prebuilds/<classifier> directory before any classpath or platform work.
  2. Classpath resource native/<classifier>/runtime.node — extracted atomically to ~/.copilot/runtime-cache/<sdk-version>/<native-version>/<classifier>/runtime.node.
  3. PATH compatibility fallback — finds copilot on PATH and accepts only a flat sibling runtime.node. This fallback does not support normal npm or Homebrew installation layouts.

  • Method Details

    • resolve

      public static Path resolve() throws IOException
      Resolves the filesystem path to the runtime.node binary.

      Follows the three-step resolution order documented on this class. The returned path is guaranteed to refer to a regular, non-empty file at the time of return.

      Returns:
      absolute path to the runtime.node binary
      Throws:
      IOException - if the binary cannot be located or extracted
      IllegalStateException - if required resources are missing or extraction fails

    • resolveEntrypoint

      public static Path resolveEntrypoint() throws IOException
      Resolves the legacy copilot CLI entrypoint from the same location as the bundled runtime.node. Callers may pass this entrypoint through copilot_runtime_host_start when legacy extension hosting is requested.

      This method calls resolve() to locate runtime.node, then looks for the copilot executable in the same directory. Both artifacts are extracted from the classifier JAR together.

      Returns:
      absolute path to the copilot CLI executable
      Throws:
      IOException - if the CLI executable cannot be located

    • resolveConfiguredEntrypoint

      public static Path resolveConfiguredEntrypoint() throws IOException
      Resolves an explicitly configured legacy CLI entrypoint, if it has a compatible adjacent runtime library.
      Returns:
      the absolute CLI path, or null when no compatible override is configured
      Throws:
      IOException - if the configured files cannot be inspected

    • resolveRuntimeWrapper

      public static Path resolveRuntimeWrapper() throws IOException
